[[File:Exocronrescue.jpg|thumb|right|[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces storm the Ministry in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].]]The '''Ministry of Technology''' was the headquarters of the [[Devisors]], the ruling caste of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exocron]]. It was a tall, castle-like structure, with towers connected by ramparts. It contained an observatory that the Devisors could use to study astronomy. The Ministry was a stronghold, and guarded by watchtowers and roving patrols.

Inside, the Ministry contained thousands of data-tapes and records concerning spaceflight and navigation, taken from the ''[[Exocros Cabal]]''. High-tech weapons and equipment, including [[Pagda Gevtes' personal walker]], were also stored in the building.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the Ministry was [[Liberation of Exocron|invaded]] by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces intent on rescuing their commanding officer, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]], who was being held in the structure.
